title: Three Days to See
subject: English
summary: “Three Days to See” is an inspiring chapter written by Helen Keller, who was blind and deaf. In this chapter, she imagines what she would do if she were given the gift of sight for just three days. On the first day, she would like to see the people she loves and the beauty of nature. On the second day, she would visit museums and enjoy the wonders of history and art. On the third day, she would observe the busy life of people in the city. Through this chapter, Helen Keller explains how wonderful the world is and how often people fail to appreciate the things they have. The chapter teaches us that we should be thankful for our blessings and enjoy the beauty of life.
